Freelance Pricing
🏗 Remote Estimation & Billing Services

Remote freelance estimation and billing support, focused on clear quantities, material reconciliation and accurate project documentation.

📊 01
Quantity Takeoff & BOQ Preparation
I extract all quantities — concrete, masonry, plaster, finishing — directly from your tender drawings and deliver a clean, item-wise Excel sheet ready for tendering or estimation.
✅ What You Get
  • Item-wise BOQ in Excel
  • Concrete, steel, brick & finishing quantities
  • Tender-ready abstract sheet
🔹 Basic quantity takeoff (starting rate)₹2.00 / Sq. Ft.
🔹 Small project (up to 50 BOQ items)From ₹2,000
⏰ Delivery: Excel file via Email / WhatsApp
📒 02
Bar Bending Schedule (BBS) & Steel Optimization
I prepare IS-2502 compliant BBS for every structural element — columns, beams, slabs, shear walls — with cut lengths and shape codes. Steel waste is minimised to save you material cost.
✅ What You Get
  • BBS per element with IS shape codes
  • Cut-length & lap-length calculations
  • Scrap optimisation to reduce wastage
🔹 Per structural element (scope-based)From ₹750
🔹 Full building (starting rate)₹1.50–₹2.50 / Sq. Ft.
⏰ Delivery: Automated Excel schedule
📋 03
Subcontractor RA Billing
Send me your raw site measurement slips and I will convert them into clean, audit-proof Measurement Books and Abstract Sheets with all deductions (TDS, Advance, Retention) calculated — ready for PMC or client approval.
✅ What You Get
  • Formatted Measurement Book (MB)
  • Abstract sheet with all deductions
  • PMC / Client approval-ready Excel
🔹 Simple bill set (starting rate)From ₹1,500 / bill
⏰ Delivery: Excel sheets via Email / WhatsApp
⭐ Best Value
📅 04
Monthly Billing Retainer
Ideal for ongoing construction sites that need consistent, reliable billing support every month without hiring a full-time engineer.
✅ What You Get
  • Up to 4 simple RA bill sets per month
  • Priority turnaround for included bill sets; extra scope quoted separately
🔹 Monthly rate (up to 4 simple bill sets)₹5,000 / month
⏰ Ongoing monthly support, all remote
📝 Note on Reconciliation: Reconciliation is done only if you assign me the full project estimation & billing. In that case it will be charged at ₹0.50 / Sq. Ft. — because understanding the full project is the only way I can accurately trace and explain every discrepancy.
📌
Minimum Engagement Fee
A minimum fee applies to small takeoff and BBS assignments. Final pricing depends on scope, drawing quality, complexity and revision requirements.
₹2,000 Minimum applies to small Quantity Takeoff or BOQ assignments under 1,000 Sq. Ft. or fewer than 25 BOQ line items. Small BBS assignments are quoted by scope. Larger projects use the applicable starting rates.
